subject: CAIQ / SIG intake – scheduling and evidence owners
messages:
From: Alex Murray <alex.murray@cyberproof-analytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@cyberproof-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ / SIG intake and preferred evidence window

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this — we (Cyberproof Analytics) are kicking off a SIG intake for our board review and would like to collect a CAIQ + supporting evidence. Would Redwood be available for a 45-min intake call this week or early next week to walk through the questionnaire, confirm scoping (SOC 2 in/out), and align on evidence owners and delivery deadlines?

Quick context: we intend to complete our CAIQ by 09/03 and the security committee has a tight sign-off window the week of 09/07. If possible, could you also share: 1) a short list of artifacts you can provide immediately (logs/architecture diagrams/SOC2 report timeline), and 2) who will be the point(s) of contact for evidence handoff?

I've attached our intake spreadsheet (Cyberproof_CAIC-2026-draft.xlsx) that flags high-priority controls. Proposed times: Wed 08/19 10:00–10:45 PT, Thu 08/20 14:00–14:45 PT, or Mon 08/24 09:00–09:45 PT.

Appreciate it —
Alex Murray
Senior Security Analyst
Cyberproof Analytics
attachments: Cyberproof_CAIC-2026-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet, 92 KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Murray <alex.murray@cyberproof-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ / SIG intake and preferred evidence window

Alex —

Thanks for the context and the intake sheet. We can do the 45-min intake on Wed 08/19 at 10:00 PT. I'll run point on the intake call; Ben (cc'd) will join for contract/scope questions and Laura will be our evidence coordinator for the CAIQ/SIG artifacts.

What we'll bring to the call:
- High-level architecture diagram and network boundary (redwood_caiq-responses-v1.pdf)
- SOC 2 status and expected report delivery window (SOC2-scoping-matrix.xlsx)
- List of readily available artifacts: ACLs, IAM role inventories, retention policy excerpts, example log extracts (we'll bring samples, not full datasets)

Prep ask for you before the call: can you highlight controls in your intake sheet that you consider blockers for committee sign-off (high priority), and confirm whether you need evidence exports (e.g., CloudTrail extracts) or screenshots/screenshares are acceptable as interim artifacts?

I'll send a calendar invite for Wed at 10:00 PT and share a Google Drive folder for evidence exchange.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Thanks Soojin — Wed 10:00 PT works for us.

A couple quick clarifications ahead of the call:
1) Blocking controls: we've flagged ~14 controls as high priority in the spreadsheet — primarily around logging retention, encryption-at-rest for customer secrets, and segmentation of customer data. I'll add inline comments in the sheet to point you to the rows.
2) Evidence format: for the committee, screenshots and time-stamped exports are acceptable as interim evidence; final delivery should be exports where possible. Where exports are PII-protected, redacted screenshots plus a hash/signed manifest is OK.

I'll join the call with our security engineer (Maya Patel) and our procurement lead (Jordan Blake) in case any procurement timelines come up.

See you Wed —
Alex

Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-call: intake summary, owners, and deadlines (CAIQ/SIG)

Ben / Laura — quick summary from the call and concrete next steps so we have this captured in one place. Alex, please correct if I missed anything.

Notes from the intake (45 min, Wed 08/19):
- Scope: CAIQ for XaaS product; SOC 2 currently in progress (expected Type II report Q4 2026). Cyberproof will accept interim artifacts for committee sign-off; final exports required pre-sign-off where feasible.
- High-priority control buckets: logging retention (6 months min), encryption at rest for customer keys, role separation for infra ops, vulnerability management evidence. Cyberproof flagged 14 rows as high priority (see their spreadsheet comments).

Action items and owners:
- Laura Bennett: create evidence matrix in the shared Drive folder (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cExampleSharedDrive). Populate with artifacts we can export by 2026-08-26. (Due: 2026-08-26)
- Soojin Lee: provide architecture diagram and redwood_caiq-responses-v1.pdf; provide guidance on acceptable redaction approaches. (Due: 2026-08-21)
- Ben Carter: confirm procurement timing and any contractual language Cyberproof needs for evidence retention or audit access; follow up on deal logistics (Deal ID RDW-2026-CYB-1178). (Due: 2026-08-25)
- Alex (Cyberproof): will add inline comments to the CAIQ spreadsheet and provide a minimal list of MUST-HAVE controls for committee sign-off by 2026-08-20.

Attachments uploaded to Drive: redwood_caiq-responses-v1.pdf, SOC2-scoping-matrix.xlsx, SOC2-log-extract-example.txt (sample logs, redacted).

Next meetings: prep sync with internal evidence owners Thu 08/20 11:00 PT (internal only); validation call with Cyberproof Wed 08/26 10:00 PT (tentative). I'll send invites.

Thanks —
Soojin
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
